output.plan: Find the semester with the latest start_date, join its course offerings and their enrollments, and average the grades. Ungraded enrollments (NULL grades) are ignored by AVG, so the average covers only graded enrollments. The semester name is selected so the answer names the semester.
output.sql: SELECT s.name, AVG(e.grade) AS average_grade FROM enrollments e JOIN course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.id JOIN semesters s ON co.semester_id = s.id WHERE s.start_date = (SELECT MAX(start_date) FROM semesters) GROUP BY s.id, s.name
